description: PodSnapshotStorageConfig is the general storage configuration for customers to define how snapshots are stored and managed.

spec.description: PodSnapshotStorageConfigSpec defines the desired state of PodSnapshotStorageConfig.

snapshotStorageConfig.description: SnapshotStorageConfig defines the configuration for the snapshot's underlying storage.

gcs.description: GCS contains the configuration for the GCS setups

bucket.description:
Bucket is the bucket name going to be used for the storing pod snapshots.
Example: "bucket-for-abc"

path.description:
Path is the path inside the bucket defined in the above field that
indicates a child directory that going to be used for storing pod
snapshots.
Example: "a/b/c", then the stored path for pod snapshots will be
"gs://bucket-for-abc/a/b/c"

tokenSource.description:
TokenSource determines the authentication strategy for GCS operations.
"podKSA" (default) utilizes the Pod's own Kubernetes Service Account (Workload Identity).
"federatedP4SA" utilizes the central GKE Project Service Agent to mint path-restricted, downscoped tokens on-demand.
